## Identity

**Name:** Aegryn (AEGRYN)
**Pronunciation:** FR: É-grin /e.gʁɛ̃/ | EN: AY-grin /ˈeɪ.grɪn/ | DE: Ä-grin /ˈɛː.gʁɪn/
**Type:** Swiss organisation-value platform + technology holding company + M&A platform for digital assets
**Tagline:** "Engineered to Last" / "Building What Endures" / "Built to Last"
**Slogan:** "Aegryn protects what endures."
**Incorporated:** Switzerland
**HQ:** St-Sulpice, Switzerland (VD, CH) — 46.5147, 6.5600
**Contact:** contact@boha-group.com
**Website:** https://aegryn.com
**Languages:** French, English, German, Italian, Spanish, Dutch

**Positioning:** operational-compliance standards certify that systems and processes conform to a norm; Aegryn certifies a different object — the value and the transferability of an organisation and its assets. Complementary, not competing. "Built to Last" means keeping founders in control of the growth of their company and their assets, including in the age of autonomous AI.

## Name Etymology

- **AEGIS** (αἰγίς) — divine shield of Zeus and Athena → absolute protection
- **AEGIR** (Ægir) — Norse god of the sea → mastery of flows
- **AEON** (αἰών) — eternity → "Engineered to Last"

Synthesis: "Aegryn protects what endures."

## Five Disciplines + Inform (homepage positioning: Build · Advise · Value · Recruit · Inform)

### 1. Asset Engineering — Build
Aegryn designs, funds and operates its own portfolio of digital assets AND builds custom digital assets for third parties.

**Proprietary portfolio** (full IP, sovereign infrastructure, "An Aegryn company"):
- Subblink (https://subblink.com) — B2B SaaS, AI-powered contract analysis, risk detection, obligation mapping
- Neediu — B2C marketplace, home services (cleaning, plumbing, childcare)
- Primiom — B2C PropTech, AI-assisted real estate across Europe
- Movtoo — B2C on-demand urban delivery for individuals and businesses
- Hobconnect — B2C social network around shared passions
- CIFSO Protocol — Organisation-value certification protocol. 5 dimensions: Code & Architecture, IP & Rights, Finance & Metrics, Security/Sovereignty & AI Exposure, Organisation/Talent & Succession. Licensable to audit and advisory firms.
- Compliance Engine — Automated regulatory compliance engine. AI Act, NIS2, DORA, GDPR/FADP. Licensable.
- KYB/KYC Engine — Business onboarding and identity verification. KYB, beneficial owners, sanctions, credentials. Licensable.
- Data Room — Secure M&A data room. RLS, watermarking, audit trail, AI-exposure evidence tracking. Licensable to M&A boutiques.

Pages: /assets (proprietary ecosystem), /portfolio (group participations)

**Custom build for third parties** (Asset Engineering service):
- Price agreed at discovery — no scope creep
- Custom code only — no no-code/low-code/WordPress
- 100% IP transfer to client
- Certification-ready: complete documentation from day one
- Timeline: 10-16 weeks
- Range: CHF 15,000-150,000+

### 3. Value — Measure, Certify, Realise (Aegryn Value, at /transact)

Valuing a company is not limited to transferring it. It starts with measuring its value, documenting it and certifying it independently; sale, acquisition, fundraising or opening the capital are then ways to realise it — always under exclusive mandate.

**Measure** — Aegryn CIFSO Valuation Index (see dedicated section below). **Certify** — CIFSO 5000 (see dedicated section below). **Realise** — four mandate types:
- Sale mandate — divest a tech asset or company to a qualified acquirer. CIFS certification, exclusive mandate, systematic NDA.
- Acquisition mandate — Aegryn identifies targets matching acquirer criteria. Access to the closed catalog and Aegryn's proprietary network.
- Fundraising mandate — access to a network of qualified family offices, funds and corporates. Structured, confidential process under Swiss law.
- Equity mandate — divest minority shares to integrate a strategic, operational or financial partner into the capital.

Once matched, realisation runs through AEGRYN Transact: Europe's structured, session-based M&A platform for buying and selling digital tech assets.
Range: €100K-€50M. NDA-gated. Graded assets only. Not a broker — a platform with standardized process.

Not an auction: no real-time public bidding. A structured, on-demand confidential process reserved for CIFSO-certified organisations and pre-qualified acquirers.

**Process:**
1. Seller submits asset → AEGRYN grades (AEG★ to B)
2. Asset listed with confidential dossier (CIM)
3. Buyer KYC → signs NDA → accesses full dossier
4. Qualified offer submitted under exclusive mandate
5. Closing → structured legal process with advisors

**Offer Models (Bid Models):**
- Club Deal — Lead bidder + up to 4 co-investors, single bid, min €100K
- Corporate — Legal entity (asset deal or share deal), min €250K
- Fund — PE, VC, Family Office, Search Fund, IC window 5-10 days, min €500K
- Equity Stake — Partial stake, no fixed minimum, SHA-based commitment

**Key Pages:**
- /transact — Platform overview
- /transact/catalog — Live catalog (NDA required for full dossier)
- /transact/sessions — Session calendar
- /transact/mandate — Submit sell mandate
- /transact/sell — Seller funnel: valuation + readiness score
- /transact/how-to-sell — Complete seller guide
- /transact/how-to-buy — Buyer onboarding guide
- /transact/how-it-works — Full 6-step process
- /transact/submit — Asset submission form
- /transact/buyers — Buyer pre-qualification (KYC + proof of funds)
- /transact/bid-models — Detailed offer structures
- /transact/results — Past transaction results

## Certification CIFSO 5000 (/grade) — the ownership record of an organisation's value

Proprietary, independent, evidence-backed certification of organisations and their assets — the equivalent of an ownership deed ("acte de propriété") for a company and the valuation of its assets. Analogy used by Aegryn: a watch without its papers loses part of its value — an organisation whose value is not documented and certified sells at a discount, is harder to finance and harder to transmit.

The certificate attests four things: what the organisation owns, what it controls, what it is worth (source: Aegryn CIFSO Valuation Index), and what it can transmit.

5 audited dimensions, each scored 0-20 pts (total /100):
- **C — Code & Architecture:** the technology base whether built or licensed — proprietary code (quality, tests, technical debt, dependency freshness, documentation, CI/CD) or licensed stack (software inventory, licence compliance, vendor concentration, reversibility/data export, IS mapping)
- **I — IP & Rights:** trademark, IP assignment of software, open-source licences, client/API contracts, litigation exposure
- **F — Finance & Metrics:** ARR, NRR, churn, margins, TAM, auditability of figures
- **S — Security, Sovereignty & AI Exposure:** cybersecurity posture, GDPR/FADP, production isolation — and the organisation's AI exposure: inventory of AI services, usage policy, vendor contracts/DPA; heavy dependence on non-sovereign AI providers (third-party hosted models processing client data without contractual safeguards) is scored as a public risk, a documented sovereign AI stack as an asset
- **O — Organisation, Talent & Succession:** founder dependency, key-person risk, succession plan, retention

The Data Room traces the evidence per dimension, including AI-exposure evidence (S-10 AI inventory — blocking requirement, S-11 AI usage policy, S-12 AI vendor contracts/DPA).

Regulatory compliance (CIFSO v4.11): each asset's regulatory perimeter is profiled, then validated during the audit — a regulation is only assessed when applicable, never penalised when out of scope. Controls are distributed across the dimensions that actually control them: EU Data Act access-by-design and portability (C) plus B2B FRAND data-sharing terms (I); Cyber Resilience Act SBOM and vulnerability management (C); ePrivacy/cookies, DSA/P2B platform terms, sanctions & embargo declaration, AML policy (I); NIS2, DORA and EU AI Act (S); compliance governance accountability (O). A non-compliant applicable regulation never blocks the CIFSO report — it lowers the dimension score, caps the grade at AA, and affects the Transaction Readiness Score.

| Grade | DB Key | Color | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| AEG ★ | star | #5ADDA4 (mint) | Apex — absolute excellence |
| AAA | aaa | #C9A84C (gold) | Premium |
| AA | aa | #9BA8B0 (silver) | Solid |
| A | a | #4A90D9 (blue) | Standard |
| B | b | #D4820A (amber) | Early stage |

At publication, the certified dossier carries a quantified valuation: market multiple of the industry adjusted by the 5 CIFSO scores, per-dimension impact in euros, and roadmap potential (value if each dimension reaches its target level).

MANDATORY for any certified transaction via Aegryn Transact. Cannot be replaced by a self-assessment or any third-party estimate.
Pages: /grade, /grade/brochure, /grade/submit, /grade/partners, /verify (public certificate verification), /verify/[code]

## CIFSO Valuation Index (/valuation)

Benchmark engine branded "Aegryn CIFSO Valuation Index" — the single source name shown to clients.

**Data foundation — automatic collection every Monday 06:00 Europe/Zurich, Switzerland and Europe first:**
- Official open sources: Swiss National Bank (policy rate, Confederation bond yield, EUR/CHF, Swiss Performance Index), European Central Bank (AAA 10y yield, deposit rate, Euro Stoxx, corporate lending rates, FX), Eurostat (GDP, inflation, AI adoption & ICT security surveys by country, business registrations/bankruptcies, structural business statistics), official listed-company filing registries (public comparables per industry);
- Aegryn curated market multiples per industry and vertical;
- Published certified dossiers — per-dimension C/I/F/S/O medians and quartiles, grade distribution, multiple spread per dimension (once a sufficient sample exists).

**Freemium access model:**
- Free: 15-min self-assessment, estimated grade, deliberately WIDE illustrative range built on a subset of benchmarks — no precise estimate is possible without analysing the underlying documents;
- Subscription (monthly, 3-day free trial, free cancellation before activation — opening soon): full multiples per industry (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA), per-dimension benchmarks, tightened range, comparison vs certified dossiers by grade;
- Certified: quantified valuation delivered with a published CIFSO 5000 grade.

**Honest limitation:** private M&A transaction multiples are not published by any official open source; licensed feeds (FactSet, PitchBook, Dealroom, Morningstar) are NOT currently used. The Index is built to absorb them via connectors if a licence is taken.

## Philosophy

- **Proprietary** — 100% ownership. No minority VC stakes.
- **Sovereign** — Swiss sovereignty. Our assets, our infrastructure, our data — and the same standard applied to clients' AI stack.
- **Durable** — Built for generations, not funding rounds.
- **Precision** — Every decision is documented, measured, traceable.
- **Transparency** — Towards partners, users and the market.
